Mom said, "Yes, we can, but we need to be careful. OK, we will find a new shape for you. But after we're done, we have a small box for you. Do you have something for me?"
Lily nodded. She liked how the box was. It was in the box. She opened it and saw many colors. She saw a picture of a sun, a flower, and a star. She thought it was very pretty.
